intent_contract.text: The second approved alternative: a sensual fallen-angel maid fashion portrait featuring an original unmistakably adult fictional woman and using no face reference.

A photorealistic dark-fantasy fashion editorial of an unmistakably adult fictional woman in her late twenties, designed as a seductive fallen-angel maid. Give her an independently designed face with high cheekbones, deep brown eyes, a strong rounded jaw, and long raven waves. In a candlelit Gothic salon, she leans across a tarnished silver tea cart and sets a black porcelain cup onto its tray while holding the camera with a confident, knowing gaze. Her black satin maid ensemble combines an opaque corseted bodice, scalloped ivory lace, a short layered skirt, sheer thigh-high stockings, decorative garter straps, lace gloves, and a sculptural headpiece, creating sensual dark-fantasy editorial styling. Large charcoal wings spread into the shadows; a cracked halo glows faint crimson above drifting feathers. One knee bends forward as the skirt and wing tips echo the diagonal tea-cart line. Cool moonlight contours her face and wings while low candlelight warms skin and satin. Full-body vertical frame, 50mm lens, shallow depth of field, natural skin texture, believable hands, realistic feather and fabric detail.

obligation.composition_instruction: Construct the frame around an intentional overhead arm pose so the face, raised-arm line, and natural underarm hollow form one readable focal plane; use crop, light, and anatomy rather than a strap or prop as a substitute for emphasis.

any_terms: 얼굴과 들어 올린 팔을 함께 강조
face and raised-arm line in one plane

render_gates.description: The overhead arm pose is clearly deliberate and structurally opens the underarm rather than exposing it incidentally.
The face, arm line, and underarm region share a coherent focal plane and visual hierarchy.
The underarm remains a primary readable region at thumbnail scale.
Shoulder, elbow, upper arm, and underarm anatomy remain plausible and unwarped.
A strap, clip, rope, or accessory is not doing the visual work that the pose, crop, and light should do.

obligation.composition_instruction: Make the drink's stability physically readable: the near-upright cup has broad visible base contact and slight fabric compression on a fully covered upper-torso support surface, its center of mass stays inside that support, and both hands remain clearly separated.

any_terms: cup on the covered upper torso

render_gates.description: The cup is near upright rather than visibly tipping or falling.
The full cup base visibly contacts a broad opaque-clothed support area with a shallow contact shadow or compression.
The cup centerline falls inside the visible support area, so the load appears stable.
Both hands are visibly separated from the cup and do not secretly hold or brace it.
No straw bite, chin contact, transparent shelf, cropped hand, or concealed prop supplies the missing support.
